A Supabase project's Postgres REST API and Storage, with its secret key.

## API key

1. Open [supabase.com](https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/settings/api-keys) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** A secret key (sb\_secret\_...) from Settings > API Keys and the project's host.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add supabase
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  supabase: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Supabase's [API](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/api) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show supabase` shows the key as set.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Supabase).
